snippet.title: Cloudrooms - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Cloudrooms is out now on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4652340/Cloudrooms/

Wake up in a mysterious corridor suspended above the clouds. Each door leads back to the beginning... unless something has changed. Observe carefully, decide whether you've found an anomaly, and see if you can escape.
